newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland's IAWS buys UK firm for 9 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Ireland's IAWS buys UK firm for 9 mln stg.

text.p: Irish agribusiness firm IAWS Group Plc said on Tuesday it had bought British specialist horticultural fertiliser manufacturer PB Kent Limited for 9.0 million stg.

IAWS also said it had sold Lisburn Proteins Limited, its by-products manufacturing facility in Northern Ireland, for 8.3 million Irish pounds, with five million payable on completion and 3.3 million in July 1998.
IAWS said that for the year to end-June 1996, attributable profits at PB Kent were 1.2 million stg and net assets were 1.7 million stg.
It said Lisburn earned pre-tax profits of 0.6 million stg in the year to end July 1996, while net assets attributable to the disposal were 2.7 million stg.
